thread:
Anna: Heads-up — planning to flip the new per-tenant routing flag `route_v3` tonight at 23:00 UTC (quiet window). Quick async check: who can own the flip and run the smoke checklist? I want rollback readiness confirmed before we touch prod.

Raj: I can do the flip and watch the dashboards. Will be online 22:45–00:30 UTC.

Micah: I’ll run the EU smoke tests once you flip. I’ve got a quick script:
```bash
curl -s -H "x-tenant-id: eu-01" https://api.redwood.example.com/route-test | jq .status
```
I’ll verify latency, 5xxs, and correctness against sample payloads.

Sofia: Oncall + rollback coverage. Confirmed we have a recent backup of routing metadata and the kill-switch is `route_v3=false` (global). I’ve added a runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/route_v3_cutover.

Anna: Thanks. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%, 15m windows. If any step shows >1% 5xx or latency p50 regresses >40ms vs baseline, we roll back immediately.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout: route_v3 scope=global stages=[10,50,100] interval=15m. Notifying owners: Raj.

Micah: One question — will we need a cache invalidation after the flip (prefix routing table change)? I don’t want stale lookups causing misroutes.

Raj: Good call. No full invalidation needed; we’ll warm the new prefix via a short traffic poke and soft-expire local caches (ttl 60s). I’ll run a small warmup script right after 10% goes green.

Sofia: Also confirming feature flag defaults: safe_default for unknown tenants = `route_v2` (old path). So unexpected tenants stay on stable path.

Anna: Exactly. I’ve set the flag config to include safe_default: "route_v2" and a kill-switch toggle for org admins.

Micah: I’ll push the smoke script to the ops repo now and link it in the runbook.

Raj: I’ll post a short status update in #incidents (ops channel) at each stage: 10%, 50%, 100%. If anything, I’ll tag @SRE and @oncall.

Sofia: I’ll be ready to cut traffic back or run the rollback playbook (steps 1–4 in the runbook). I confirmed KMS keys are usable if we need to reconfigure routing secrets.

Anna: Perfect. Final checklist:
- Raj: flip + monitor dashboards (22:59 UTC flip start)
- Micah: smoke EU + sample tenants after each stage
- Sofia: rollback + keys + runbook standing by
- Anna: watch canary metrics and coordinate comms

Anna: If no objections, proceeding with the scheduled flip. :thumbsup:
